C0_T1_C1_2.name: Lotch
C0_T1_C1_2.text: Is there something the Veil Above could help you with?

C0_T1_C1_3.name: Lotch
C0_T1_C1_3.text: Tera does not concern herself with the comings and goings of her children. If you are looking for someone, ask a lesser god.

C0_T1_C1_4.name: Lotch
C0_T1_C1_4.text: And if none avail themselves to you, ask a mortal.

C0_T1_C1_5.name: Lotch
C0_T1_C1_5.text: One by the name Neve lives around here. Dark hair, red clothes.

C0_T1_C1_6.name: Lotch
C0_T1_C1_6.text: If she can\'t help you, I'm afraid your lord isn't here.

C0_T1_C1_8.name: Lotch
C0_T1_C1_8.text: Give yourself to her once you are finished with your earthly conquests.

C0_T1_C1_9.name: Lotch
C0_T1_C1_9.text: If she finds you worthy, you may recieve blessings.

C1_T1_C1_2.name: Neve
C1_T1_C1_2.text: You'll have to be more specific. Lords of all over pass through here.
C1_T1_C1_2.options: His name is Hudris. You two are aquainted.

C1_T1_C1_3.name: Neve
C1_T1_C1_3.text: You shouldn't believe everything you hear.

C1_T1_C1_4.name: Neve
C1_T1_C1_4.text: I might know of someone by that name.

C1_T1_C1_5.name: Neve
C1_T1_C1_5.text: If you're the guard you look like, you'll know where to search.

C2_T1_C1_1.name: Swan
C2_T1_C1_1.text: Hello. Is there something the Rind Guard could help you with?

C2_T1_C1_2.name: Swan
C2_T1_C1_2.text: Does she? Tell me why you're really here.
C2_T1_C1_2.options: I'm looking for a lord, Hudris of Camithenya.

C2_T1_C1_3.name: Swan
C2_T1_C1_3.text: Yes, he's here. In the apartments.

C2_T1_C1_4.name: Swan
C2_T1_C1_4.text: You'll have to figure out which one.

C2_T1_C1_5.name: Swan
C2_T1_C1_5.text: If you see that wretch again, tell her the grass is yellow.

C2_T1_C1_6.name: Swan
C2_T1_C1_6.text: And don't ever speak to me again.

C2_T1_C1_7.name: Swan
C2_T1_C1_7.text: The fields know no limit. And many workers make bountiful crop.

Hudris_3.name: Hudris
Hudris_3.text: Do they? You don't have to do this, you know.

Hudris_4.name: Hudris
Hudris_4.text: I can help you with that problem of yours. You've met my contacts in djkdal/

Hudris_5.name: Hudris
Hudris_5.options: Is this not the fraud charge I was informed of?

Hudris_6.name: Hudris
Hudris_6.text: Worse than blasphemy. It's a miracle I'm still here.

Hudris_7.name: Hudris
Hudris_7.text: We were friends once. You remember.
Hudris_7.options: It's hard to remember with the Captain's breath on my neck

Hudris_8.name: Hudris
Hudris_8.text: Then don't go back. You don't even work for them.
Hudris_8.options: I can't have my reputation sullied.

Hudris_9.name: Hudris
Hudris_9.text: I don't have a golden cushion to fall back on.

Hudris_10.name: Hudris
Hudris_10.text: They won't keep me in those dungeons for long.

Hudris_11.name: Hudris
Hudris_11.options: What I don't understand is why you're still here. You wanted me to find you.

Hudris_12.name: Hudris
Hudris_12.options: You can get out Hudris. The day you stop fighting is the day you die.

Hudris_17.name: Hudris
Hudris_17.text: I'm not here.  I left before you could find me.

Hudris_18.name: Hudris
Hudris_18.text: Search Davruin, by the ruins. There's a small cottage on the cliffside.

Hudris_19.name: Hudris
Hudris_19.text: I've got family there. Distant, just the kind you need to disappear. They've seen me recently.

Hudris_20.name: Hudris
Hudris_20.text: Mathis. He was drunk, in the Seedy Barrel. He didn't even recognize the badge.

Hudris_22.name: Hudris
Hudris_22.text: And may her punishments stray from your family.
